pages.title: A new shower head · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a large hardware store in Denver. The aisles are full of tools, boxes and paint. Rita holds the broken shower head in her hand. She does not know where to start. A clerk named Gus walks up with a smile. His apron has many small pockets.
“Welcome! What can I help you find?” says Gus. “My shower head broke yesterday.” says Rita. “Oh no. What happened?” says Gus.

paragraphs: “Great. How much is everything?” says Rita. “Thirty-two dollars. Do you need help installing it?” says Gus. Rita buys a shower head, a wrench and tape.
